title: CLI & Developer Tools
summary: This module provides command-line interfaces for users to interact with CrewAI functionalities and developer tools to streamline the development and release process of CrewAI projects.

nodes.label: Handle CLI Authentication & API
nodes.title: CLI Auth & API Interaction
nodes.description: Manages user authentication, secure communication with the CrewAI+ API, and telemetry initialization for CLI commands.

nodes.label: Main CLI Entry Point
nodes.title: CrewAI CLI Access
nodes.description: The primary command-line interface for users to access all CrewAI functionalities, dispatching to various sub-commands.

nodes.label: Manage Crews & Flows
nodes.title: Crew & Flow Operations
nodes.description: Provides commands for executing, training, testing, and interacting with CrewAI agents and flows, including chat and flow plotting.

nodes.label: Manage Deployments
nodes.title: Deployment Lifecycle Management
nodes.description: Offers commands for creating, pushing, listing, monitoring, validating, and removing CrewAI project deployments on the platform.

nodes.label: Manage Tools & Configuration
nodes.title: Tool & CLI Settings Management
nodes.description: Includes commands for creating, installing, publishing tools, configuring CLI settings, managing organizations, and handling user authentication/logout.

nodes.label: Manage Checkpoints & Tracing
nodes.title: Checkpoint & Tracing Control
nodes.description: Commands for resuming, diffing, listing, and pruning execution checkpoints, as well as enabling, disabling, and checking tracing status.

nodes.label: Scaffold New Projects
nodes.title: New Project Creation
nodes.description: Facilitates the creation of new CrewAI projects by copying template files and setting up initial project structures from predefined templates.

nodes.label: Automate Versioning & Releases
nodes.title: Automated Versioning & Release
nodes.description: Provides tools for automatically bumping package versions, creating Git tags, generating release notes, and managing GitHub releases.

nodes.label: Automate Documentation
nodes.title: AI-Powered Docs Generation
nodes.description: Generates and translates documentation based on code changes, leveraging AI to create and update content for releases and localization.

nodes.label: Interact with CrewAI Core
nodes.title: CrewAI Core Framework
nodes.description: The underlying CrewAI framework providing agents, tasks, and flow execution logic that CLI commands operate on.

nodes.label: Connect to CrewAI+ Platform
nodes.title: CrewAI+ Platform Services
nodes.description: The cloud platform providing backend services for deployments, tool repositories, telemetry, and advanced CrewAI features.

nodes.label: Utilize Git SCM
nodes.title: Git Source Control Management
nodes.description: The external Git version control system used by developer tools for managing code, branches, tags, and pull requests.

nodes.label: Access LLM Services
nodes.title: External LLM Providers
nodes.description: External Large Language Model services used by developer tools for tasks like generating release notes and documentation content.

groups.label: CLI Foundation
groups.title: Core CLI Infrastructure
groups.description: The foundational components that handle user authentication, API communication, and serve as the main entry point for all command-line interactions.

groups.label: CLI Operations
groups.title: Comprehensive CLI Commands
groups.description: A suite of command-line tools for managing CrewAI projects, including crew execution, flow orchestration, deployment, tool management, configuration, and tracing.

groups.label: Developer Tools
groups.title: Project & Release Automation
groups.description: Utilities designed to streamline the development workflow, from project creation and version management to automated documentation generation and Git operations.

groups.label: External Integrations
groups.title: External Systems & Core Modules
groups.description: Represents the external systems and core CrewAI modules that the CLI and developer tools interact with to perform their functions.
